head: 2a0f8d74ab913c84245055cee2ccba1b83c799a0
scope: Independent preflight source review of the two new Native-only agent QEMU files. No Cargo, product CLI, helper, USB, ptrace or QEMU execution. No repository edit.

closed_findings.finding: Background HID reader could open evdev after QMP injection
closed_findings.closure: Parent shell opens evdev FD3 before launching reader; reader closes duplicate3/control5; WAIT only after subscription is established.

closed_findings.finding: New Store has no committed state.json before first mutation, so initial cp deterministically failed
closed_findings.closure: Before denial records actual absent status and actual public empty jobs/sessions responses. First permission-denial audit creates the real file. No fake prior raw state is generated.

closed_findings.finding: Final server all/terminal/metrics assertions allowed empty session history
closed_findings.closure: history_identity requires exact two-server-job/eight-session and four-client-job/four-session sets with original start/held IDs, role counts, instance/key/principal and each capability attempt preserved; terminal counts are exact nonzero8/4.

closed_findings.finding: Kernel S0 loop guard could miss final output between last read and guest exit
closed_findings.closure: verify rereads both complete S0 logs after actual QEMU exits and rejects the same Kernel panic/Oops markers.

additional_hardening_verified: Root terminal proof must equal NativeImportReleased/NativeExportRestored/NativeStubAvailable by capability kind even if app proof was not populated; PreviousBoot/Gone/NotStarted are rejected in this fixed sameboot/nohotplug scenario.
Captured helper status requires all actual UID columns0; agents require all UID columns2000 and zero Inh/Prm/Eff/Amb capabilities.
lifecycle_checks_reviewed: UID1000 operators return from real CLI Start before QMP/HID/FTDI I/O; UID1002/unknown profile reject without new root capabilities.
Actual source/backend pool is Native only, TLS-managed catalog+IMPORT+URB; no production input RPC and no host USB passthrough.
Per-incoming HID stop retains exact serial export/stub/import resource and another35B actual serial I/O; exported device sessions remain available.
SIGKILL targets the harness-owned agent PID and captures one actual wait137, preserves old application identity/attempt without rewriting old terminal0.
Helper remains alive to perform its own kernel cleanup; old serial app session resolves only by exact retained helper proof after new application epoch.
Server TERM verifies the complete original driver/configuration/interface generation baseline before restart; new epochs/attempt IDs and final real HID/FTDI I/O are distinct.
Actual FTDI injected and received byte files compare three exact35B rounds per direction (105B), and evdev records require KEY1/KEY3 down/up.
Listener/capability/metadata/helper roots are separate; root policy has no legacy export/peer permission and no trusted_network bypass.
Both guests must exit0 with one exact PASS each and complete artifact framing; source/HEAD/clean and actual ELF receipts are checked before PASS.
Host creates QEMU socketpair NICs and emulated keyboard/FTDI only; host module/USB/network mutation is absent. Kernel copy is bounded existing support behavior.
First failure is retained; ABORT triggers guest trap and a bounded25s diagnostic grace collects artifacts before host termination.
limits: Static preflight is not actual USB or product-run evidence. Author static fixtures are kept separate and are not independently promoted to device tests.
Only Native/IPv4 or Native/IPv6 is selectable; virtual and USBFS managed integration matrices are not implemented by these files.
TTY fd4 is closed at the end of I/O round2. KILL proves a still Connected capability lifecycle, not a specifically observed active USB URB/kernel ioctl at that instant.
TCP/TLS packet classification is the existing shared support; this review does not call runner.verify/pcap_review or claim independent packet analysis of a run that has not happened.
No hardware G1/G2, all-family execution, FD revocation or full Phase3 completion claim.
reviewer_notes: The first final textual check used an exact whitespace needle and raised ValueError; corrected whitespace-tolerant source predicate passes. This was not a harness run or product failure.
